spans.s:
योद्धव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be fought or contended,
to be overcome in battle, (the neuter may be used
impersonally, e. g. कैर् मया सह योद्धव्यम्,
by whom is it to be fought with me.)

योद्धव्य योद्धव्य, योद्धृ, योध, योधिन्,
&c. See p. 820, col. 1.

योद्धु-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, wishing to fight,
anxious for battle.

योद्धृ, धा, m. a fighter, warrior, champion,
combatant, soldier.
